title: H2 confinement rejects every database (FoodMart included) when saiku.home is reached through a symlink

criteria.given: an H2 candidate path whose database file does not exist yet (an H2 URL names the database without .mv.db) under a symlinked saiku.home
criteria.then: containment resolves the nearest existing ancestor with toRealPath() and appends the remainder — the candidate is compared against the home's real path, so the seeded FoodMart H2 database under a symlinked saiku.home is accepted, not rejected

criteria.given: a symlink inside an allowed root whose target escapes it
criteria.then: the candidate is still judged on its target: resolving the nearest existing ancestor must not let an existing symlink's escape through, and an unresolvable path (root missing entirely) still falls back to the lexical form so ../ traversal keeps being refused

criteria.given: the regression test the issue asks for
criteria.then: a test with a symlinked saiku.home opens (validates) the FoodMart H2 database URL, and a guard-level test covers a not-yet-existing file under a symlinked root
